name: exfil/s3
description: Exfiltrate execution role credentials to an attacker-controlled S3 bucket via Glue job

options.name: EXFIL_BUCKET
options.description: Attacker-controlled S3 bucket name for credential exfiltration

options.name: EXFIL_PREFIX
options.description: S3 key prefix for the exfiltrated data (e.g., 'loot/')

options.name: INCLUDE_ENV
options.description: Include Glue environment variables in the exfiltrated payload (true/false)
